{{Quote|An information bunker was too big a prize for an ''[sic]'' tactical droid to resist. We'll take this back to the cruiser and run a robolobotomy. Who knows what secrets it might hold?|Aayla Secura, on the tactical droid's head|<ref name="Headgames" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Hoping to obtain information held in the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)|tactical droid]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], along with [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and three other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], set a trap by fabricating an [[information bunker]], which&mdash;as the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] was led to believe&mdash;stored important [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] data files. A force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] commanded by the tactical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] soon walked right into the trap, where they were attacked by the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. The clones quickly destroyed the tactical droid's escort, and Secura beheaded the droid herself. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then took the droid's head in order to perform a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] and discover what secrets it held.

==The battle==
{{Quote|I'm far too valuable to be scrapped. I'm&hellip;I'm&hellip;''"<br />"''You're ''cornered''.|The tactical droid and Aayla Secura|<ref name="Headgames" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] attempted to obtain information held in the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)|tactical droid]]. In order to do this, Secura and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] set a trap by fabricating an [[information bunker]], which&mdash;as the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would think&mdash;served as a storage for important [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] data files. After setting the trap, Secura hid inside the bunker, while the clones took position above the canyon leading to it.<ref name="Headgames" />

[[File:Objective_complete.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone troopers rejoin Aayla Secura inside the bunker.]]
Soon, a force of Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] commanded by the [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]]-mounted [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] moved toward the fake bunker, hoping to obtain the data files. The droids broke into the bunker, only to discover from several [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|retrieval droids]] that the data banks were empty. At that moment, taking advantage of the droids' confusion, the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] launched an assault on the droid forces, using [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to make a swift landing in the canyon.<ref name="Headgames" />

Clone troopers [[Galle/Legends|Galle]] and [[Barr]] took out the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] while trooper [[Inc]] used [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] on the remaining [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Meanwhile, the tactical droid attempted to retreat into the bunker but was intercepted there by Secura, who [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] him with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The droid did not have time to trigger the data-erasing protective reflex called [[cyberostasis]] before being decapitated, and his memory banks were left intact as a result.<ref name="Headgames" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|A nicely played distraction, Bly.|Aayla Secura, after the battle|<ref name="Headgames" />}}
Once her team joined her in the bunker, Secura commended them on their efforts in successfully completing the mission. Secura then decided to perform a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] on the droid's head aboard her [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to discover what information it held.<ref name="Headgames" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Headgames|''Headgames'']], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]] that takes place before "[[Jedi Crash]],"<ref name="Headgames" /> an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Jedi Crash Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> The issue was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]],<ref name="Headgames" /> and published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[January 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="TCWarchives">{{SWArchive|url=archives|text=Archives}}</ref>
